sign_off.notes:
Swept the four requested areas on the nine provided files plus temporary files created/renamed/deleted for testing.

Confirmed/logged bugs:
1) Temperatures: bare negative temperature quantities are wrong (-5 celsius shows -551.30 °C; -10 celsius in fahrenheit shows -969.34 °F; -40 fahrenheit in celsius shows -550.74 °C; -65 fahrenheit in celsius shows -564.63 °C). Positive values (25 celsius = 25 °C) and temperature sums (25C+5C=30C, 20C-5C=15C, 10C+18F=2.22C) are correct.
2) Percentages: variable-based percentage forms fail with "Err"/"Unexpected %" (disc% of price, disc% off price, tax% of 1200). Literal forms work (10% of 80 = 8; 15% off 240 = 204; 15% of 240 = 36 in a scratch line).
3) Totals/summaries: avg includes the preceding total result (Expenses avg shows 812.88 instead of 541.92); grand_total double-counts total lines (Monthly budget shows 5,700 instead of 2,850 — developer said already logged). Verified the same total/avg inclusion on a temporary file (100, 200, avg=150, total=450).
4) Rename dialog preselect: current name is prefilled but not selected — typing appends (Expenses → Expensesx) and one Delete removes only one character (Expenses → Expense); long-press "Select all" does not select the name. Reported twice but the developer could not reproduce, so it is not logged; flagging it as an unverified concern.

Other checks passed: Expenses total 1,625.75; Monthly budget section totals 2,800.50 and 49.50; number bases, date gaps and time differences all correct; remainders correct; rotation preserves data; creating a file with content persists across app restart, empty new files are discarded, rename save/cancel work, empty name disables Rename, deletion works. Test files were removed; the original nine files remain.
